caption: The video depicts a close-up view of a metalworking task, in which a weld seam on a dark metal beam is being cleaned or chipped. The beam rests on a wooden slatted surface and is held in place by a rusty C-clamp, while a person's lower leg, clad in blue jeans and a dark shoe, stays stationary near the workpiece. A hand encased in a thick tan leather glove grips a slender metal tool and drives it in rapid, repetitive striking motions along the seam. The tool alternates between being raised and contacting the metal, moving fast enough to produce visible motion blur. The striking motion remains continuous, with no pause visible between the rapid blows. As the chipping continues, the point of contact remains around the same weld seam near the clamp. The foot, the beam, and the clamp do not visibly move, keeping the workpiece fixed.
